$comment: A maintained file, not a live API — F1's only free calendar API is community-run with no stability guarantee, and boxing/UFC have no free API at all. Dates checked against two independent sources where noted; 'note' flags anything worth re-verifying closer to the date. Re-check and extend each month: this file is only as good as the last time someone looked at it.
